```
# Wymaga działającego stacku RetailDW (sieć `retaildw_default`, usługa `postgres`).

    mem_limit: 2g
    command: ["standalone"]

      AIRFLOW__DATABASE__SQL_ALCHEMY_CONN: postgresql+psycopg2://airflow:${AIRFLOW_DB_PASSWORD:?Ustaw AIRFLOW_DB_PASSWORD w airflow/.env}@postgres:5432/airflow
      AIRFLOW__CORE__FERNET_KEY: ${AIRFLOW_FERNET_KEY:?Ustaw AIRFLOW_FERNET_KEY w airflow/.env}
```

```
name: retaildw

services:
  postgres:
    # Same image line as ds-ml-linux-setup (pgvector/pgvector:pg17); override with PG_IMAGE.
    image: ${PG_IMAGE:-pgvector/pgvector:pg17}
    restart: "no"
    cpus: 2
    mem_limit: 2g
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?Set POSTGRES_PASSWORD in .env}
      RETAILDW_PASSWORD: ${RETAILDW_PASSWORD:?Set RETAILDW_PASSWORD in .env}
      RETAILDW_RO_PASSWORD: ${RETAILDW_RO_PASSWORD:?Set RETAILDW_RO_PASSWORD in .env}
    command: ["postgres", "-c", "shared_buffers=256MB", "-c", "work_mem=32MB"]
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${PG_PORT:-5433}:5432"
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      # TCP check: during first-start initdb the server only listens on the unix socket.
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -d postgres"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 30
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"

volumes:
  pgdata:
```
</details></tool-use>

```
# Nordvik - sprzedaz i stany sezonowych modeli odziezy (dane do analizy)

Wyciag z hurtowni danych sieci Nordvik (5 sklepow stacjonarnych i sklep internetowy) oraz jednorazowy eksport stanow magazynowych.
Waluta: PLN. `UnitPrice`, `ListPrice`, `GrossAmount`, `DiscountAmount` sa kwotami brutto (z VAT 23%); `NetAmount` jest netto.
Pliki: Parquet (kompresja zstd), odczyt np. `pandas.read_parquet`.

## Zakres

| Tabela | Wierszy | Zakres |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dim_date` | 761 | 2024-12-01 ... 2026-12-31 |
| `dim_store` | 6 | 5 sklepow stacjonarnych + sklep internetowy |
| `dim_product` | 816 | 96 modeli, SKU = model x kolor x rozmiar |
| `merch_plan` | 96 | plan wprowadzenia modeli w 4 kolekcjach |
| `fact_sales` | 475,524 | 2025-02-02 ... 2026-09-20 (pozycje paragonow) |
| `fact_inventory_daily` | 649,196 | 2025-02-01 ... 2026-09-20 (migawka stanu na koniec dnia) |

Stan danych: 2026-09-20. Ostatnia kolekcja (`AW26`) jest w trakcie sezonu.

## Slownik danych

- `dim_date`: `DateKey` (int, yyyymmdd), `Date`, `Year`, `Quarter`, `Month`, `MonthName`, `YearMonth` (np. 2026-09), `IsoYear`, `IsoWeek`, `YearWeek` (np. 2026-W38), `DayOfWeek` (1 = poniedzialek), `DayName`, `IsWeekend`, `Season` (SS<rr> lub AW<rr>; styczen nalezy do AW poprzedniego roku).
- `dim_store`: `StoreKey`, `StoreCode`, `StoreName`, `City`, `Region`, `Channel` (STORE / ONLINE), `Format`, `SalesAreaM2` (powierzchnia biezaca), `OpenedDate`, `RemodelDate`.
- `dim_product`: `ProductKey`, `SKU` (= `StyleCode`-kod koloru-rozmiar), `StyleCode`, `StyleName`, `Department`, `Category`, `Color`, `Size` (XS, S, M, L, XL lub ONE dla akcesoriow), `ListPrice` (brutto), `UnitCost` (koszt jednostkowy netto), `IsActive` (1 = model w biezacej sprzedazy).
- `merch_plan`: `StyleCode`, `Collection` (SS25, AW25, SS26, AW26), `LaunchDate` (planowana data wprowadzenia), `PlannedUnits` (plan z systemu planowania).
```

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Manage the local RetailDW PostgreSQL database (docker compose + psql inside the container).
# Run `./retaildw.sh help` for the command list.
set -euo pipefail

CALLER_PWD=$PWD
ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
# Relative paths only from here on: Git Bash path rewriting breaks absolute paths passed to docker.exe.
cd "$ROOT"
DB_DIR=db

DB_NAME=retaildw
OWNER=retaildw
RO_USER=retaildw_ro

die()  { echo "error: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
info() { echo "==> $*"; }

usage() {
    cat <<'EOF'
Usage: ./retaildw.sh <command> [options]

Lifecycle
  up                 Start the container if needed, then run baseline and migrate.
  down               Stop and remove the container; the data volume is kept.
  reset [-y|--yes]   DESTROY the data volume, then rebuild everything (setup). Asks first.
  setup              up + seed + load: a complete working database from scratch (safe to repeat).

Schema and data
  baseline           Idempotent setup: roles (passwords re-synced from .env), database, schemas, grants.
  migrate            Apply outstanding db/migrations/V###__*.sql (each in one transaction, tracked
                     in ops.schema_migrations with a checksum).
  seed               Seed dimensions and generate source data into src.* (no-op if already filled).
  load               Full reload of stg.* and dw.* from src.* via etl.load_* procedures.

Inspect
  status             Container, connection info, migration state and row counts.
  query [opts] SQL   Run SQL. Options: --ro (read-only role), --csv, -f FILE. SQL may also be piped in.
  psql [--ro]        Interactive psql session.
  logs [args]        Container logs (default: last 100 lines; e.g. `logs -f`).

Settings come from .env (copy .env.example). Examples:
  ./retaildw.sh setup
  ./retaildw.sh query "SELECT year_month, SUM(net_amount) FROM reporting.sales_daily GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1"
  ./retaildw.sh query --ro --csv -f report.sql > report.csv
EOF
}
```

```
"""E1: test klienta z hosta (parametr, metryka, artefakt, model: zapis i odczyt z serwera)."""
import inspect
import os
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import mlflow
import numpy as np
from mlflow import MlflowClient
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression

URI = os.getenv("MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI", "http://127.0.0.1:5000")
mlflow.set_tracking_uri(URI)
print("klient mlflow:", mlflow.__version__, "| serwer:", URI)
print("sygnatura log_model (sklearn):", inspect.signature(mlflow.sklearn.log_model))

mlflow.set_experiment("bc04-e1-test-klienta")
X = np.array([[0.0], [1.0], [2.0], [3.0]])
y = np.array([0, 0, 1, 1])
with mlflow.start_run(run_name="e1-test") as run:
    mlflow.log_param("metoda", "test")
    mlflow.log_metric("brier", 0.25)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        fig, ax = plt.subplots()
        ax.plot([0, 1], [0, 1])
        ax.set_title("test artefaktu")
        p = Path(td) / "wykres.png"
        fig.savefig(p)
        mlflow.log_artifact(str(p))
    info = mlflow.sklearn.log_model(LogisticRegression().fit(X, y), name="model", input_example=X[:2])

c = MlflowClient()
r = c.get_run(run.info.run_id)
assert r.data.params["metoda"] == "test" and abs(r.data.metrics["brier"] - 0.25) < 1e-12
arts = [a.path for a in c.list_artifacts(run.info.run_id)]
assert "wykres.png" in arts, arts
loaded = mlflow.sklearn.load_model(info.model_uri)
assert loaded.predict(X).tolist() == [0, 0, 1, 1]
print("OK: parametr, metryka, artefakt i model zapisane i odczytane;", "model_uri:", info.model_uri)

```

```
"""Uruchamia KOPIĘ notebooka BC-04 (oryginał bez zmian) i zapisuje liczby referencyjne do parytetu."""
import os
import time
from pathlib import Path

import nbformat
from nbclient import NotebookClient

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SRC_NB = HERE.parent / "bc04-sell-through-przecena.ipynb"
OUT = HERE / "reference"
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
os.environ["NORDVIK_BC04_DATA"] = str((HERE.parents[2] / "datasets/synthetic/bc04").resolve())

nb = nbformat.read(SRC_NB, as_version=4)
nb.cells.append(nbformat.v4.new_code_cell(
    "O.to_parquet('ref_O_final.parquet'); tab6.to_csv('ref_tab6.csv'); dt.to_csv('ref_pairs.csv'); D.to_parquet('ref_D.parquet')"
))
t0 = time.time()
NotebookClient(nb, timeout=7200, kernel_name="python3", resources={"metadata": {"path": str(OUT)}}).execute()
(OUT / "elapsed_s.txt").write_text(f"{time.time() - t0:.1f}\n")
nbformat.write(nb, OUT / "bc04-executed-copy.ipynb")
print("OK, czas [s]:", round(time.time() - t0, 1))
```

```
from scipy.optimize import curve_fit
from scipy.stats import norm
from sklearn.isotonic import IsotonicRegression
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression, Ridge
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.model_selection import GroupKFold
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=FutureWarning)

SEED = 20260920
COST = dict(delta=0.20, delta_clear=0.25, hold_m=0.015, hold_months=2, eps=0.50, tau=0.60)
TAU = COST["tau"]
EPS = COST["eps"]
DAYS = [13, 20, 27, 34, 41, 48]
HIST = ["SS25", "AW25", "SS26"]
COLLS = ["SS25", "AW25", "SS26"]
GRID = np.round(np.arange(0.05, 0.96, 0.05), 2)
TABLES = ["dim_date", "dim_store", "dim_product", "merch_plan", "fact_sales", "fact_inventory_daily"]


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- dane (notebook: Load Data, 2.1-2.5, Transform)
def build_dataset(data_dir: Path, cache_dir: Path) -> SimpleNamespace:
    cache_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    con = duckdb.connect()
    for t in TABLES:
        con.execute(f"CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW {t} AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('{(data_dir / (t + '.parquet')).as_posix()}')")
    dim_store = con.sql("SELECT * FROM dim_store").df()
    dim_product = con.sql("SELECT * FROM dim_product").df()
    merch_plan = con.sql("SELECT * FROM merch_plan").df()
    con.execute("""CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW pm AS
        SELECT p.ProductKey, p.SKU, p.StyleCode, p.Category, p.Size, p.Color, p.ListPrice, p.UnitCost,
               m.Collection, m.LaunchDate, m.PlannedUnits
        FROM dim_product p JOIN merch_plan m USING (StyleCode)""")
    con.execute("""CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW sales_pm AS
        SELECT CAST(d.Date AS DATE) AS Date, f.StoreKey, f.Quantity, f.UnitPrice, f.DiscountAmount, f.GrossAmount, f.NetAmount,
               f.UnitCost AS SaleUnitCost, pm.ProductKey, pm.StyleCode, pm.Category, pm.Size, pm.Collection, pm.LaunchDate
        FROM fact_sales f JOIN pm USING (ProductKey) JOIN dim_date d USING (DateKey)""")
    con.execute("""CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW inv_pm AS
        SELECT CAST(d.Date AS DATE) AS Date, i.StoreKey, i.ProductKey, i.StockQuantity,
               pm.StyleCode, pm.Category, pm.Size, pm.Collection, pm.LaunchDate
        FROM fact_inventory_daily i JOIN pm USING (ProductKey) JOIN dim_date d USING (DateKey)""")

    # 2.3: pierwsza faktyczna sprzedaż modelu
    first_sale = con.sql("SELECT StyleCode, min(Date) AS first_sale FROM sales_pm GROUP BY 1").df()
    first_sale["first_sale"] = pd.to_datetime(first_sale.first_sale)
    mp = merch_plan.merge(first_sale, on="StyleCode")
    first_sale_map = pd.Series(mp.set_index("StyleCode").first_sale)
    con.execute("CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE fs AS SELECT * FROM (SELECT StyleCode, min(Date) AS first_sale FROM sales_pm GROUP BY 1)")

    # 2.5: dzień pierwszego rabatu modelu
    ds = con.sql("""
        SELECT s.StyleCode, s.Quantity,
               round(s.DiscountAmount / (s.Quantity * s.UnitPrice), 3) AS rate, date_diff('day', fs.first_sale, s.Date) AS age_d
        FROM sales_pm s JOIN fs USING (StyleCode)""").df()
    fd_map = ds[ds.rate > 0].groupby("StyleCode").age_d.min()

    # Transform: dzienne serie modeli
    inv = con.sql("SELECT Date, StoreKey, ProductKey, StockQuantity AS st FROM inv_pm").df()
    sal = con.sql("""SELECT Date, StoreKey, ProductKey, sum(Quantity) AS q, sum(CASE WHEN DiscountAmount > 0 THEN Quantity ELSE 0 END) AS qd
                     FROM sales_pm GROUP BY ALL""").df()
    for d_ in (inv, sal):
        d_["Date"] = pd.to_datetime(d_["Date"])
    sku = con.sql("SELECT ProductKey, StyleCode, Collection, Size, Category FROM pm").df()
    stores = sorted(dim_store.StoreKey)

    def build_collection(coll):
        sk = sku[sku.Collection == coll].sort_values("ProductKey").reset_index(drop=True)
        cols = {(p, s): j for j, (p, s) in enumerate(itertools.product(sk.ProductKey, stores))}
        i = inv[inv.ProductKey.isin(sk.ProductKey)]
        dates = pd.date_range(i.Date.min(), i.Date.max())
        di = pd.Series(range(len(dates)), index=dates)
        S = np.full((len(dates), len(cols)), np.nan)
        ri, ci = i.Date.map(di).to_numpy(), np.array([cols[(p, s)] for p, s in zip(i.ProductKey, i.StoreKey)])
        S[ri, ci] = np.maximum(i.st.to_numpy(), 0)
        Q, QD = np.zeros_like(S), np.zeros_like(S)
        s_ = sal[sal.ProductKey.isin(sk.ProductKey) & sal.Date.isin(dates)]
        rs, cs_ = s_.Date.map(di).to_numpy(), np.array([cols[(p, s)] for p, s in zip(s_.ProductKey, s_.StoreKey)])
        Q[rs, cs_], QD[rs, cs_] = s_.q.to_numpy(), s_.qd.to_numpy()
        seen = ~np.isnan(S)
        first_obs = np.where(seen.any(0), seen.argmax(0), len(dates))
        S_imp, IMP = S.copy(), np.zeros(S.shape, bool)
        for d in range(len(dates)):
            miss = np.isnan(S_imp[d])
            if miss.any():
                prev = S_imp[d - 1] if d > 0 else np.zeros(S.shape[1])
                S_imp[d, miss] = np.maximum(np.nan_to_num(prev[miss]) - Q[d, miss], 0)
                IMP[d, miss] = d > first_obs[miss]
        S_imp = np.nan_to_num(S_imp)
        mcol = np.repeat(sk.StyleCode.to_numpy(), len(stores))
        gs = lambda M: pd.DataFrame(M, index=dates).T.groupby(mcol).sum().T
        stock, imp_stock = gs(S_imp), gs(S_imp * IMP)
        cum, cumd, u = gs(Q).cumsum(), gs(QD).cumsum(), gs(Q)
        net = S_imp.reshape(len(dates), len(sk), len(stores)).sum(2) > 0
        core = sk.Size.isin(["M", "L", "ONE"]).to_numpy()
        av = lambda mask: pd.DataFrame(net[:, mask], index=dates).T.groupby(sk.StyleCode.to_numpy()[mask]).mean().T
        parts = {"stock": stock, "imp_stock": imp_stock, "cum": cum, "cumd": cumd, "u": u, "avail_core": av(core), "avail_all": av(np.ones(len(sk), bool))}
        out = pd.concat({k: v.stack() for k, v in parts.items()}, axis=1).rename_axis(["Date", "StyleCode"]).reset_index()
        out["Collection"] = coll
        return out

    ms = pd.concat([build_collection(c) for c in ["SS25", "AW25", "SS26", "AW26"]], ignore_index=True)
    ms["first_sale"] = ms.StyleCode.map(first_sale_map)
    ms["age_d"] = (ms.Date - ms.first_sale).dt.days
    ms = ms[ms.age_d >= 0].sort_values(["StyleCode", "age_d"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    ms["supply"] = ms.cum + ms.stock
    ms["st"] = ms.cum / ms.supply
    ms["u7"] = ms.groupby("StyleCode").u.transform(lambda s: s.rolling(7, min_periods=1).sum())
    CAT = sku.drop_duplicates("StyleCode").set_index("StyleCode").Category
    ms["Category"] = ms.StyleCode.map(CAT)
    ms["first_disc_d"] = ms.StyleCode.map(fd_map)

    # Transform: tabela modelowa
    prod = dim_product.merge(merch_plan, on="StyleCode", how="left")
    prod["net_price"] = prod["ListPrice"] / 1.23
    P_ = {k: ms.pivot(index="StyleCode", columns="age_d", values=k) for k in ["cum", "supply", "stock", "st", "u7", "avail_core", "avail_all"]}
    price = prod.groupby("StyleCode").agg(p=("net_price", "first"), c=("UnitCost", "first"))
    mod = ms.groupby("StyleCode").agg(Collection=("Collection", "first"), Category=("Category", "first"),
                                      first_disc_d=("first_disc_d", "first"), age_max=("age_d", "max"))

    def cum_at(day):
        return P_["cum"][day] if day >= 0 else pd.Series(0.0, index=P_["cum"].index)

    def rows_at(d, models):
        ix = models
        r = pd.DataFrame(index=ix)
        r["d"], r["k"] = d, (d + 1) // 7
        r["Collection"], r["Category"], r["first_disc_d"] = mod.Collection.reindex(ix), mod.Category.reindex(ix), mod.first_disc_d.reindex(ix)
        r["st_d"], r["cum_d"], r["supply_d"] = P_["st"][d].reindex(ix), P_["cum"][d].reindex(ix), P_["supply"][d].reindex(ix)
        r["rate14"] = ((cum_at(d) - cum_at(d - 14)) / 14 / P_["supply"][d]).reindex(ix)
        r["pred55"] = np.minimum(1.0, r.st_d + r.rate14 * (55 - d))
        r["trend"] = np.log((P_["u7"][d] + 1) / (P_["u7"][d - 7] + 1)).reindex(ix)
        r["avail_core"], r["avail_all"] = P_["avail_core"][d].reindex(ix), P_["avail_all"][d].reindex(ix)
        r["restock"] = (P_["supply"][d] / P_["supply"][0] - 1).reindex(ix)
        r["ln_price"] = np.log(price.p.reindex(ix))
        r["p"], r["c"] = price.p.reindex(ix), price.c.reindex(ix)
        r["cum55"], r["supply55"], r["st55"] = P_["cum"][55].reindex(ix), P_["supply"][55].reindex(ix), P_["st"][55].reindex(ix)
        r["q_rest"] = r.cum55 - r.cum_d
        return r.reset_index()

    hist_models = mod.index[mod.Collection.isin(HIST)]
    D_all = pd.concat([rows_at(d, hist_models) for d in DAYS], ignore_index=True)
    D_all["censored"] = D_all.first_disc_d < 56
    D = D_all[~D_all.censored].reset_index(drop=True)
    cats = sorted(D_all.Category.unique())
    for _df in (D, D_all):
        _df["cat"] = _df.Category.map({c: i for i, c in enumerate(cats)})

    # M3: dopasowania krzywej (cache w katalogu zadania)
    m3_file = cache_dir / "m3_curve_fits.parquet"
    if m3_file.exists():
        _m3 = pd.read_parquet(m3_file)
    else:
        out = []
        for i, r in enumerate(D_all.itertuples()):
            c55, sd = fit_curve(P_["cum"].loc[r.StyleCode].to_numpy(), int(r.d), seed=SEED + i)
            out.append((min(c55 / r.supply_d, 1.0) if c55 == c55 else np.nan, sd / r.supply_d if sd == sd else np.nan))
        _m3 = pd.DataFrame(out, columns=["mu3", "s_fit"], index=D_all.index)
        _m3.insert(0, "key", D_all.StyleCode + "|" + D_all.d.astype(str))
        _m3.to_parquet(m3_file)
    _m3k = _m3.set_index("key")
    for _df in (D, D_all):
        key = _df.StyleCode + "|" + _df.d.astype(str)
        _df["mu3"], _df["s_fit"] = key.map(_m3k.mu3).to_numpy(), key.map(_m3k.s_fit).to_numpy()
    return SimpleNamespace(D=D, D_all=D_all, ms=ms, P_=P_, mod=mod, cats=cats)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- M3 (notebook: Faza 6)
def _curve(t, A, th):
    return A * (1 - np.exp(-(t + 1) / th))


def fit_curve(cum_series, d, n_boot=40, seed=0):
    t = np.arange(d + 1, dtype=float)
    y = cum_series[: d + 1].astype(float)
    cd = y[-1]

    def one(yy):
        try:
            p, _ = curve_fit(_curve, t, yy, p0=[cd * 1.5, 40.0], bounds=([max(cd, 1.0), 2.0], [cd * 8 + 10, 400.0]), maxfev=4000)
            return p
        except Exception:
            return np.array([np.nan, np.nan])

    p0 = one(y)
    if np.isnan(p0[0]):
        return np.nan, np.nan
    res = y - _curve(t, *p0)
    rg = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    c55 = [_curve(55.0, *one(np.maximum.accumulate(_curve(t, *p0) + rg.choice(res, len(res))))) for _ in range(n_boot)]
    return _curve(55.0, *p0), float(np.nanstd(c55))


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- ocena (notebook: Faza 5-7)
def label(df, tau):
    return (df.st55 < tau).astype(int).to_numpy()


def cost_table(df, tau, delta=None, d_clear=None, eps=None, hold=None):
    delta = COST["delta"] if delta is None else delta
    d_clear = COST["delta_clear"] if d_clear is None else d_clear
    eps = EPS if eps is None else eps
    hold = COST["hold_m"] if hold is None else hold
    S = np.maximum(0.0, tau * df.supply55 - df.cum55)
    k_miss = (S * (d_clear * df.p + hold * COST["hold_months"] * df.c)).to_numpy()
    k_flag = (delta * df.p * df.q_rest).to_numpy()
    return pd.DataFrame({"c_no": k_miss, "c_flag": k_flag + (1 - eps) * k_miss, "k_flag": k_flag, "k_miss": k_miss}, index=df.index)


def theory_threshold(df, tau, **kw):
    ct, y = cost_table(df, tau, **kw), pd.Series(label(df, tau), index=df.index)
    eps = EPS if kw.get("eps") is None else kw["eps"]
    out = {}
    for k_, ix in df.groupby("k").groups.items():
        out[k_] = float(np.clip(ct.loc[ix, "k_flag"].mean() / (eps * ct.loc[ix, "k_miss"].sum() / max(y.loc[ix].sum(), 1)), 0.02, 0.98))
    return out


def pick_threshold(df, p, tau, **kw):
    ct, out = cost_table(df, tau, **kw), {}
    c_flag, c_no = ct.c_flag.to_numpy(), ct.c_no.to_numpy()
    for k_, ix in df.reset_index(drop=True).groupby("k").indices.items():
        tot = [np.where(p[ix] > t, c_flag[ix], c_no[ix]).sum() for t in GRID]
        out[k_] = float(GRID[np.isclose(tot, np.min(tot))].max())
    return out


def _sigma(resid, k_tr, k_te):
    s = pd.Series(resid).groupby(k_tr).std(ddof=1)
    return np.maximum(pd.Series(k_te).map(s).fillna(s.mean()).to_numpy(), 0.03)


def m_B0g(tr, te, tau):
    return np.full(len(te), label(tr, tau).mean())


def m_B0(tr, te, tau):
    y = pd.Series(label(tr, tau), index=tr.index)
    n, g = tr.groupby("Category").size(), y.mean()
    w = n / (n + 30)
    est = w * y.groupby(tr.Category).mean() + (1 - w) * g
    return te.Category.map(est).fillna(g).to_numpy()


def m_B1(tr, te, tau):
    s = _sigma((tr.st55 - tr.pred55).to_numpy(), tr.k.to_numpy(), te.k.to_numpy())
    return norm.cdf((tau - te.pred55.to_numpy()) / s)


def m_B2(tr, te, tau):
    res = tr.st55 - tr.pred55
    n = tr.groupby("Category").size()
    bias = res.groupby(tr.Category).mean() * (n / (n + 30))
    s = _sigma((res - tr.Category.map(bias)).to_numpy(), tr.k.to_numpy(), te.k.to_numpy())
    mu = te.pred55 + te.Category.map(bias).fillna(0.0)
    return norm.cdf((tau - mu.to_numpy()) / s)


FE_M1 = ["pred55", "st_d", "trend", "avail_core", "restock", "ln_price", "k"]
FE_M2 = FE_M1 + ["rate14", "avail_all", "cat"]


def make_logit(feats, C=1.0):
    def f(tr, te, tau):
        m = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(C=C, max_iter=2000)).fit(tr[feats], label(tr, tau))
        return m.predict_proba(te[feats])[:, 1]
    return f


def make_ridge(feats, alpha=3.0):
    def f(tr, te, tau):
        m = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), Ridge(alpha=alpha)).fit(tr[feats], tr.st55)
        res = (tr.st55 - m.predict(tr[feats])).to_numpy() * np.sqrt(len(tr) / (len(tr) - len(feats) - 1))
        return norm.cdf((tau - m.predict(te[feats])) / _sigma(res, tr.k.to_numpy(), te.k.to_numpy()))
    return f


def _gbm():
    return lgb.LGBMClassifier(n_estimators=150, learning_rate=0.03, max_depth=2, num_leaves=4, min_child_samples=20, subsample=0.8, subsample_freq=1,
                              colsample_bytree=0.8, reg_lambda=5.0, random_state=SEED, verbose=-1, n_jobs=1)


def _logit(p):
    p = np.clip(p, 1e-4, 1 - 1e-4)
    return np.log(p / (1 - p))


def make_gbm(feats, cal=None):
    def f(tr, te, tau):
        X, y = tr[feats], label(tr, tau)
        p_te = _gbm().fit(X, y).predict_proba(te[feats])[:, 1]
        if cal is None:
            return p_te
        oof = np.zeros(len(tr))
        for a, b in GroupKFold(5).split(X, y, tr.StyleCode):
            oof[b] = _gbm().fit(X.iloc[a], y[a]).predict_proba(X.iloc[b])[:, 1]
        if cal == "platt":
            return LogisticRegression(C=1e6).fit(_logit(oof).reshape(-1, 1), y).predict_proba(_logit(p_te).reshape(-1, 1))[:, 1]
        return IsotonicRegression(out_of_bounds="clip", y_min=0, y_max=1).fit(oof, y).predict(p_te)
    return f


def m_M3(tr, te, tau):
    ok = tr.mu3.notna()
    res = (tr.st55 - tr.mu3)[ok]
    bias_k = res.groupby(tr.k[ok]).mean()
    s_k = _sigma((res - tr.k[ok].map(bias_k)).to_numpy(), tr.k[ok].to_numpy(), te.k.to_numpy())
    mu = te.mu3 + te.k.map(bias_k).fillna(0.0)
    sd = np.sqrt(te.s_fit.fillna(0.0).to_numpy() ** 2 + s_k ** 2)
    p = norm.cdf((tau - mu.to_numpy()) / sd)
    return np.where(te.mu3.isna(), np.nan, p)


BASE = {"B0g": m_B0g, "B0": m_B0, "B1": m_B1, "B2": m_B2}
METH = {
    **BASE,
    "M1a": make_logit(FE_M1),
    "M1a bez avail_core": make_logit([f for f in FE_M1 if f != "avail_core"]),
    "M1a bez ln_price": make_logit([f for f in FE_M1 if f != "ln_price"]),
    "M1a bez restock": make_logit([f for f in FE_M1 if f != "restock"]),
    "M1r": make_ridge(FE_M1),
    "M2": make_gbm(FE_M2),
    "M2 + Platt": make_gbm(FE_M2, "platt"),
    "M2 + izotoniczna": make_gbm(FE_M2, "iso"),
    "M3": m_M3,
}
# cechy per metoda (do parametrów uruchomień); None = metoda bez cech z tabeli (częstość bazowa) lub wyłącznie pred55
FEATURES = {
    "B0g": [], "B0": ["Category"], "B1": ["pred55"], "B2": ["pred55", "Category"],
    "M1a": FE_M1, "M1a bez avail_core": [f for f in FE_M1 if f != "avail_core"],
    "M1a bez ln_price": [f for f in FE_M1 if f != "ln_price"], "M1a bez restock": [f for f in FE_M1 if f != "restock"],
    "M1r": FE_M1, "M2": FE_M2, "M2 + Platt": FE_M2, "M2 + izotoniczna": FE_M2, "M3": ["mu3", "s_fit"],
}
HYPER = {
    "B0g": "brak", "B0": "skurczenie n/(n+30) do częstości globalnej", "B1": "sigma_k z treningu; P=Phi((tau-pred55)/sigma_k)",
    "B2": "korekta kategorii skurczona n/(n+30)",
    "M1a": "LogisticRegression C=1, L2, StandardScaler", "M1a bez avail_core": "jak M1a bez avail_core",
    "M1a bez ln_price": "jak M1a bez ln_price", "M1a bez restock": "jak M1a bez restock",
    "M1r": "Ridge alpha=3 na st55, P=Phi((tau-mu)/sigma_k)",
    "M2": "LGBM depth=2 leaves=4 n=150 lr=0.03 reg_lambda=5 min_child=20 subsample=0.8 colsample=0.8 n_jobs=1",
    "M2 + Platt": "jak M2 + kalibracja Platta (OOF GroupKFold 5)", "M2 + izotoniczna": "jak M2 + kalibracja izotoniczna (OOF GroupKFold 5)",
    "M3": "krzywa A(1-exp(-(t+1)/theta)), bootstrap reszt 40x, bias_k i sigma_k z treningu",
}


def run_cv(methods, tau, data):
    outs = []
    for test_c in COLLS:
        tr, te = data[data.Collection != test_c], data[data.Collection == test_c]
        o = te.copy()
        o["y"] = label(te, tau)
        for name, f in methods.items():
            inner = pd.concat([pd.Series(f(tr[tr.Collection != c], tr[tr.Collection == c], tau), index=tr[tr.Collection == c].index)
                               for c in tr.Collection.unique()])
            o["p__" + name] = f(tr, te, tau)
            o["thr__" + name] = te.k.map(pick_threshold(tr.loc[inner.index], inner.to_numpy(), tau)).to_numpy()
        o["thr_theory"] = te.k.map(theory_threshold(tr, tau)).to_numpy()
        outs.append(o)
    return pd.concat(outs, ignore_index=True)


def ridge_mu_sd(tr, te, feats=FE_M1, alpha=3.0):
    m = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), Ridge(alpha=alpha)).fit(tr[feats], tr.st55)
    res = (tr.st55 - m.predict(tr[feats])).to_numpy() * np.sqrt(len(tr) / (len(tr) - len(feats) - 1))
    return m.predict(te[feats]), _sigma(res, tr.k.to_numpy(), te.k.to_numpy())


def ev_flag(te, mu, sd, tau, delta=None, d_clear=None, eps=None, hold=None):
    delta = COST["delta"] if delta is None else delta
    d_clear = COST["delta_clear"] if d_clear is None else d_clear
    eps = EPS if eps is None else eps
    hold = COST["hold_m"] if hold is None else hold
    z = (tau - mu) / sd
    exp_short = sd * (norm.pdf(z) + z * norm.cdf(z))
    k_miss = exp_short * te.supply_d.to_numpy() * (d_clear * te.p.to_numpy() + hold * COST["hold_months"] * te.c.to_numpy())
    k_flag = delta * te.p.to_numpy() * np.maximum(mu - te.st_d.to_numpy(), 0) * te.supply_d.to_numpy()
    return k_flag + (1 - eps) * k_miss < k_miss


def add_ev(O, D, tau=TAU):
    """Prognoza ciągła M1r (uczona na kolekcjach treningowych foldu) i flaga reguły kosztowej EV."""
    O["mu_r"], O["sd_r"] = np.nan, np.nan
    for c in COLLS:
        tr_, te_ = D[D.Collection != c], D[D.Collection == c]
        mu_, sd_ = ridge_mu_sd(tr_, te_)
        ix = O.index[O.Collection == c]
        O.loc[ix, "mu_r"], O.loc[ix, "sd_r"] = mu_, sd_
    O["flag__EV"] = ev_flag(O, O.mu_r.to_numpy(), O.sd_r.to_numpy(), tau)
    return O


def policy_cost(O, tau, flag, **kw):
    ct = cost_table(O, tau, **kw)
    return np.where(flag, ct.c_flag, ct.c_no)


def rule_cost(O, m, tau, which="tuned", **kw):
    thr = O["thr__" + m] if which == "tuned" else O["thr_theory"]
    return policy_cost(O, tau, O["p__" + m] > thr, **kw)


def basic_policies(O, tau):
    return {"nie flaguj nigdy": np.zeros(len(O), bool), "flaguj zawsze": np.ones(len(O), bool),
            "praktyka robocza (ST < prosta do celu)": (O.st_d < tau * (O.d + 1) / 56).to_numpy()}


def boot_setup(O, B=1000, seed=SEED):
    ids = O.StyleCode.unique()
    return ids, np.random.default_rng(seed).multinomial(len(ids), np.ones(len(ids)) / len(ids), size=B)


def _by_model(O, vals, ids):
    t = pd.DataFrame({"v": np.asarray(vals, float), "n": 1.0, "id": O.StyleCode.to_numpy()}).groupby("id").sum().reindex(ids)
    return t.v.to_numpy(), t.n.to_numpy()


def boot_mean(O, vals, bs):
    ids, W = bs
    v, n = _by_model(O, vals, ids)
    return v.sum() / n.sum(), np.quantile((W @ v) / (W @ n), [0.05, 0.95])


def sq_err(O, m):
    return (O["p__" + m] - O.y) ** 2


def log_loss_rows(O, m):
    p = O["p__" + m].clip(1e-3, 1 - 1e-3)
    return -(O.y * np.log(p) + (1 - O.y) * np.log(1 - p))


def ece(p, y, bins=5):
    b = np.minimum((np.asarray(p) * bins).astype(int), bins - 1)
    return sum((b == i).mean() * abs(np.asarray(p)[b == i].mean() - np.asarray(y)[b == i].mean()) for i in range(bins) if (b == i).any())


def auc(O, m):
    return roc_auc_score(O.y, O["p__" + m]) if O["p__" + m].nunique() > 1 else 0.5


def calib_curve(O, m, bins=5, B=400, seed=3):
    b = np.minimum((O["p__" + m] * bins).astype(int), bins - 1).to_numpy()
    ids_ = O.StyleCode.unique()
    rg = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    out = []
    for i in range(bins):
        msk = b == i
        if msk.sum() < 5:
            continue
        v, n = _by_model(O, np.where(msk, O.y, 0), ids_)[0], _by_model(O, msk.astype(float), ids_)[0]
        Wb = rg.multinomial(len(ids_), np.ones(len(ids_)) / len(ids_), size=B)
        den = Wb @ n
        est = np.where(den > 0, (Wb @ v) / np.where(den > 0, den, 1), np.nan)
        out.append((O["p__" + m][msk].mean(), O.y[msk].mean(), *np.nanquantile(est, [.05, .95]), int(msk.sum())))
    return pd.DataFrame(out, columns=["p_śr", "udział", "od", "do", "n"])


def run_main_cv(ds: SimpleNamespace):
    """Cała walidacja z fazy 6: LOCO dla wszystkich metod + EV. Zwraca tabelę out-of-fold (jak `O` w notebooku)."""
    O = run_cv(METH, TAU, ds.D)
    O["p__M3"] = O["p__M3"].fillna(O["p__B1"])
    return add_ev(O, ds.D)
```

```
"""Rdzeń obliczeń BC-04 przeniesiony z notebooka bc04-sell-through-przecena.ipynb (fazy 2-7) bez zmian logiki.

Cel: te same liczby co w notebooku (parytet), ale wywoływalne z kodu pod śledzeniem MLflow.
Źródło każdej funkcji: odpowiednia komórka notebooka (nazwy zachowane).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import itertools
import warnings
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

import duckdb
import lightgbm as lgb
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.optimize import curve_fit
from scipy.stats import norm
from sklearn.isotonic import IsotonicRegression
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression, Ridge
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.model_selection import GroupKFold
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=FutureWarning)

SEED = 20260920
COST = dict(delta=0.20, delta_clear=0.25, hold_m=0.015, hold_months=2, eps=0.50, tau=0.60)
TAU = COST["tau"]
EPS = COST["eps"]
DAYS = [13, 20, 27, 34, 41, 48]
HIST = ["SS25", "AW25", "SS26"]
COLLS = ["SS25", "AW25", "SS26"]
GRID = np.round(np.arange(0.05, 0.96, 0.05), 2)
TABLES = ["dim_date", "dim_store", "dim_product", "merch_plan", "fact_sales", "fact_inventory_daily"]


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- dane (notebook: Load Data, 2.1-2.5, Transform)
def build_dataset(data_dir: Path, cache_dir: Path) -> SimpleNamespace:
    cache_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    con = duckdb.connect()
    for t in TABLES:
        con.execute(f"CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW {t} AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('{(data_dir / (t + '.parquet')).as_posix()}')")
    dim_store = con.sql("SELECT * FROM dim_store").df()
    dim_product = con.sql("SELECT * FROM dim_product").df()
    merch_plan = con.sql("SELECT * FROM merch_plan").df()
    con.execute("""CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW pm AS
        SELECT p.ProductKey, p.SKU, p.StyleCode, p.Category, p.Size, p.Color, p.ListPrice, p.UnitCost,
               m.Collection, m.LaunchDate, m.PlannedUnits
        FROM dim_product p JOIN merch_plan m USING (StyleCode)""")
    con.execute("""CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW sales_pm AS
        SELECT CAST(d.Date AS DATE) AS Date, f.StoreKey, f.Quantity, f.UnitPrice, f.DiscountAmount, f.GrossAmount, f.NetAmount,
               f.UnitCost AS SaleUnitCost, pm.ProductKey, pm.StyleCode, pm.Category, pm.Size, pm.Collection, pm.LaunchDate
        FROM fact_sales f JOIN pm USING (ProductKey) JOIN dim_date d USING (DateKey)""")
    con.execute("""CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW inv_pm AS
        SELECT CAST(d.Date AS DATE) AS Date, i.StoreKey, i.ProductKey, i.StockQuantity,
               pm.StyleCode, pm.Category, pm.Size, pm.Collection, pm.LaunchDate
        FROM fact_inventory_daily i JOIN pm USING (ProductKey) JOIN dim_date d USING (DateKey)""")

    # 2.3: pierwsza faktyczna sprzedaż modelu
    first_sale = con.sql("SELECT StyleCode, min(Date) AS first_sale FROM sales_pm GROUP BY 1").df()
    first_sale["first_sale"] = pd.to_datetime(first_sale.first_sale)
    mp = merch_plan.merge(first_sale, on="StyleCode")
    first_sale_map = pd.Series(mp.set_index("StyleCode").first_sale)
    con.execute("CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE fs AS SELECT * FROM (SELECT StyleCode, min(Date) AS first_sale FROM sales_pm GROUP BY 1)")

    # 2.5: dzień pierwszego rabatu modelu
    ds = con.sql("""
        SELECT s.StyleCode, s.Quantity,
               round(s.DiscountAmount / (s.Quantity * s.UnitPrice), 3) AS rate, date_diff('day', fs.first_sale, s.Date) AS age_d
        FROM sales_pm s JOIN fs USING (StyleCode)""").df()
    fd_map = ds[ds.rate > 0].groupby("StyleCode").age_d.min()

    # Transform: dzienne serie modeli
    inv = con.sql("SELECT Date, StoreKey, ProductKey, StockQuantity AS st FROM inv_pm").df()
    sal = con.sql("""SELECT Date, StoreKey, ProductKey, sum(Quantity) AS q, sum(CASE WHEN DiscountAmount > 0 THEN Quantity ELSE 0 END) AS qd
                     FROM sales_pm GROUP BY ALL""").df()
    for d_ in (inv, sal):
        d_["Date"] = pd.to_datetime(d_["Date"])
    sku = con.sql("SELECT ProductKey, StyleCode, Collection, Size, Category FROM pm").df()
    stores = sorted(dim_store.StoreKey)

    def build_collection(coll):
        sk = sku[sku.Collection == coll].sort_values("ProductKey").reset_index(drop=True)
        cols = {(p, s): j for j, (p, s) in enumerate(itertools.product(sk.ProductKey, stores))}
        i = inv[inv.ProductKey.isin(sk.ProductKey)]
        dates = pd.date_range(i.Date.min(), i.Date.max())
        di = pd.Series(range(len(dates)), index=dates)
        S = np.full((len(dates), len(cols)), np.nan)
        ri, ci = i.Date.map(di).to_numpy(), np.array([cols[(p, s)] for p, s in zip(i.ProductKey, i.StoreKey)])
        S[ri, ci] = np.maximum(i.st.to_numpy(), 0)
        Q, QD = np.zeros_like(S), np.zeros_like(S)
        s_ = sal[sal.ProductKey.isin(sk.ProductKey) & sal.Date.isin(dates)]
        rs, cs_ = s_.Date.map(di).to_numpy(), np.array([cols[(p, s)] for p, s in zip(s_.ProductKey, s_.StoreKey)])
        Q[rs, cs_], QD[rs, cs_] = s_.q.to_numpy(), s_.qd.to_numpy()
        seen = ~np.isnan(S)
        first_obs = np.where(seen.any(0), seen.argmax(0), len(dates))
        S_imp, IMP = S.copy(), np.zeros(S.shape, bool)
        for d in range(len(dates)):
            miss = np.isnan(S_imp[d])
            if miss.any():
                prev = S_imp[d - 1] if d > 0 else np.zeros(S.shape[1])
                S_imp[d, miss] = np.maximum(np.nan_to_num(prev[miss]) - Q[d, miss], 0)
                IMP[d, miss] = d > first_obs[miss]
        S_imp = np.nan_to_num(S_imp)
        mcol = np.repeat(sk.StyleCode.to_numpy(), len(stores))
        gs = lambda M: pd.DataFrame(M, index=dates).T.groupby(mcol).sum().T
        stock, imp_stock = gs(S_imp), gs(S_imp * IMP)
        cum, cumd, u = gs(Q).cumsum(), gs(QD).cumsum(), gs(Q)
        net = S_imp.reshape(len(dates), len(sk), len(stores)).sum(2) > 0
        core = sk.Size.isin(["M", "L", "ONE"]).to_numpy()
        av = lambda mask: pd.DataFrame(net[:, mask], index=dates).T.groupby(sk.StyleCode.to_numpy()[mask]).mean().T
        parts = {"stock": stock, "imp_stock": imp_stock, "cum": cum, "cumd": cumd, "u": u, "avail_core": av(core), "avail_all": av(np.ones(len(sk), bool))}
        out = pd.concat({k: v.stack() for k, v in parts.items()}, axis=1).rename_axis(["Date", "StyleCode"]).reset_index()
        out["Collection"] = coll
        return out

    ms = pd.concat([build_collection(c) for c in ["SS25", "AW25", "SS26", "AW26"]], ignore_index=True)
    ms["first_sale"] = ms.StyleCode.map(first_sale_map)
    ms["age_d"] = (ms.Date - ms.first_sale).dt.days
    ms = ms[ms.age_d >= 0].sort_values(["StyleCode", "age_d"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    ms["supply"] = ms.cum + ms.stock
    ms["st"] = ms.cum / ms.supply
    ms["u7"] = ms.groupby("StyleCode").u.transform(lambda s: s.rolling(7, min_periods=1).sum())
    CAT = sku.drop_duplicates("StyleCode").set_index("StyleCode").Category
    ms["Category"] = ms.StyleCode.map(CAT)
    ms["first_disc_d"] = ms.StyleCode.map(fd_map)

    # Transform: tabela modelowa
    prod = dim_product.merge(merch_plan, on="StyleCode", how="left")
    prod["net_price"] = prod["ListPrice"] / 1.23
    P_ = {k: ms.pivot(index="StyleCode", columns="age_d", values=k) for k in ["cum", "supply", "stock", "st", "u7", "avail_core", "avail_all"]}
    price = prod.groupby("StyleCode").agg(p=("net_price", "first"), c=("UnitCost", "first"))
    mod = ms.groupby("StyleCode").agg(Collection=("Collection", "first"), Category=("Category", "first"),
                                      first_disc_d=("first_disc_d", "first"), age_max=("age_d", "max"))

    def cum_at(day):
        return P_["cum"][day] if day >= 0 else pd.Series(0.0, index=P_["cum"].index)

    def rows_at(d, models):
        ix = models
        r = pd.DataFrame(index=ix)
        r["d"], r["k"] = d, (d + 1) // 7
        r["Collection"], r["Category"], r["first_disc_d"] = mod.Collection.reindex(ix), mod.Category.reindex(ix), mod.first_disc_d.reindex(ix)
        r["st_d"], r["cum_d"], r["supply_d"] = P_["st"][d].reindex(ix), P_["cum"][d].reindex(ix), P_["supply"][d].reindex(ix)
        r["rate14"] = ((cum_at(d) - cum_at(d - 14)) / 14 / P_["supply"][d]).reindex(ix)
        r["pred55"] = np.minimum(1.0, r.st_d + r.rate14 * (55 - d))
        r["trend"] = np.log((P_["u7"][d] + 1) / (P_["u7"][d - 7] + 1)).reindex(ix)
        r["avail_core"], r["avail_all"] = P_["avail_core"][d].reindex(ix), P_["avail_all"][d].reindex(ix)
        r["restock"] = (P_["supply"][d] / P_["supply"][0] - 1).reindex(ix)
        r["ln_price"] = np.log(price.p.reindex(ix))
        r["p"], r["c"] = price.p.reindex(ix), price.c.reindex(ix)
        r["cum55"], r["supply55"], r["st55"] = P_["cum"][55].reindex(ix), P_["supply"][55].reindex(ix), P_["st"][55].reindex(ix)
        r["q_rest"] = r.cum55 - r.cum_d
        return r.reset_index()

    hist_models = mod.index[mod.Collection.isin(HIST)]
    D_all = pd.concat([rows_at(d, hist_models) for d in DAYS], ignore_index=True)
    D_all["censored"] = D_all.first_disc_d < 56
    D = D_all[~D_all.censored].reset_index(drop=True)
    cats = sorted(D_all.Category.unique())
    for _df in (D, D_all):
        _df["cat"] = _df.Category.map({c: i for i, c in enumerate(cats)})

    # M3: dopasowania krzywej (cache w katalogu zadania)
    m3_file = cache_dir / "m3_curve_fits.parquet"
    if m3_file.exists():
        _m3 = pd.read_parquet(m3_file)
    else:
        out = []
        for i, r in enumerate(D_all.itertuples()):
            c55, sd = fit_curve(P_["cum"].loc[r.StyleCode].to_numpy(), int(r.d), seed=SEED + i)
            out.append((min(c55 / r.supply_d, 1.0) if c55 == c55 else np.nan, sd / r.supply_d if sd == sd else np.nan))
        _m3 = pd.DataFrame(out, columns=["mu3", "s_fit"], index=D_all.index)
        _m3.insert(0, "key", D_all.StyleCode + "|" + D_all.d.astype(str))
        _m3.to_parquet(m3_file)
    _m3k = _m3.set_index("key")
    for _df in (D, D_all):
        key = _df.StyleCode + "|" + _df.d.astype(str)
        _df["mu3"], _df["s_fit"] = key.map(_m3k.mu3).to_numpy(), key.map(_m3k.s_fit).to_numpy()
    return SimpleNamespace(D=D, D_all=D_all, ms=ms, P_=P_, mod=mod, cats=cats)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- M3 (notebook: Faza 6)
def _curve(t, A, th):
    return A * (1 - np.exp(-(t + 1) / th))


def fit_curve(cum_series, d, n_boot=40, seed=0):
    t = np.arange(d + 1, dtype=float)
    y = cum_series[: d + 1].astype(float)
    cd = y[-1]

    def one(yy):
        try:
            p, _ = curve_fit(_curve, t, yy, p0=[cd * 1.5, 40.0], bounds=([max(cd, 1.0), 2.0], [cd * 8 + 10, 400.0]), maxfev=4000)
            return p
        except Exception:
            return np.array([np.nan, np.nan])

    p0 = one(y)
    if np.isnan(p0[0]):
        return np.nan, np.nan
    res = y - _curve(t, *p0)
    rg = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    c55 = [_curve(55.0, *one(np.maximum.accumulate(_curve(t, *p0) + rg.choice(res, len(res))))) for _ in range(n_boot)]
    return _curve(55.0, *p0), float(np.nanstd(c55))


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- ocena (notebook: Faza 5-7)
def label(df, tau):
    return (df.st55 < tau).astype(int).to_numpy()


def cost_table(df, tau, delta=None, d_clear=None, eps=None, hold=None):
    delta = COST["delta"] if delta is None else delta
    d_clear = COST["delta_clear"] if d_clear is None else d_clear
    eps = EPS if eps is None else eps
    hold = COST["hold_m"] if hold is None else hold
    S = np.maximum(0.0, tau * df.supply55 - df.cum55)
    k_miss = (S * (d_clear * df.p + hold * COST["hold_months"] * df.c)).to_numpy()
    k_flag = (delta * df.p * df.q_rest).to_numpy()
    return pd.DataFrame({"c_no": k_miss, "c_flag": k_flag + (1 - eps) * k_miss, "k_flag": k_flag, "k_miss": k_miss}, index=df.index)


def theory_threshold(df, tau, **kw):
    ct, y = cost_table(df, tau, **kw), pd.Series(label(df, tau), index=df.index)
    eps = EPS if kw.get("eps") is None else kw["eps"]
    out = {}
    for k_, ix in df.groupby("k").groups.items():
        out[k_] = float(np.clip(ct.loc[ix, "k_flag"].mean() / (eps * ct.loc[ix, "k_miss"].sum() / max(y.loc[ix].sum(), 1)), 0.02, 0.98))
    return out


def pick_threshold(df, p, tau, **kw):
    ct, out = cost_table(df, tau, **kw), {}
    c_flag, c_no = ct.c_flag.to_numpy(), ct.c_no.to_numpy()
    for k_, ix in df.reset_index(drop=True).groupby("k").indices.items():
        tot = [np.where(p[ix] > t, c_flag[ix], c_no[ix]).sum() for t in GRID]
        out[k_] = float(GRID[np.isclose(tot, np.min(tot))].max())
    return out


def _sigma(resid, k_tr, k_te):
    s = pd.Series(resid).groupby(k_tr).std(ddof=1)
    return np.maximum(pd.Series(k_te).map(s).fillna(s.mean()).to_numpy(), 0.03)


def m_B0g(tr, te, tau):
    return np.full(len(te), label(tr, tau).mean())


def m_B0(tr, te, tau):
    y = pd.Series(label(tr, tau), index=tr.index)
    n, g = tr.groupby("Category").size(), y.mean()
    w = n / (n + 30)
    est = w * y.groupby(tr.Category).mean() + (1 - w) * g
    return te.Category.map(est).fillna(g).to_numpy()


def m_B1(tr, te, tau):
    s = _sigma((tr.st55 - tr.pred55).to_numpy(), tr.k.to_numpy(), te.k.to_numpy())
    return norm.cdf((tau - te.pred55.to_numpy()) / s)


def m_B2(tr, te, tau):
    res = tr.st55 - tr.pred55
    n = tr.groupby("Category").size()
    bias = res.groupby(tr.Category).mean() * (n / (n + 30))
    s = _sigma((res - tr.Category.map(bias)).to_numpy(), tr.k.to_numpy(), te.k.to_numpy())
    mu = te.pred55 + te.Category.map(bias).fillna(0.0)
    return norm.cdf((tau - mu.to_numpy()) / s)


FE_M1 = ["pred55", "st_d", "trend", "avail_core", "restock", "ln_price", "k"]
FE_M2 = FE_M1 + ["rate14", "avail_all", "cat"]


def make_logit(feats, C=1.0):
    def f(tr, te, tau):
        m = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(C=C, max_iter=2000)).fit(tr[feats], label(tr, tau))
        return m.predict_proba(te[feats])[:, 1]
    return f


def make_ridge(feats, alpha=3.0):
    def f(tr, te, tau):
        m = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), Ridge(alpha=alpha)).fit(tr[feats], tr.st55)
        res = (tr.st55 - m.predict(tr[feats])).to_numpy() * np.sqrt(len(tr) / (len(tr) - len(feats) - 1))
        return norm.cdf((tau - m.predict(te[feats])) / _sigma(res, tr.k.to_numpy(), te.k.to_numpy()))
    return f


def _gbm():
    return lgb.LGBMClassifier(n_estimators=150, learning_rate=0.03, max_depth=2, num_leaves=4, min_child_samples=20, subsample=0.8, subsample_freq=1,
                              colsample_bytree=0.8, reg_lambda=5.0, random_state=SEED, verbose=-1, n_jobs=1)


def _logit(p):
    p = np.clip(p, 1e-4, 1 - 1e-4)
    return np.log(p / (1 - p))


def make_gbm(feats, cal=None):
    def f(tr, te, tau):
        X, y = tr[feats], label(tr, tau)
        p_te = _gbm().fit(X, y).predict_proba(te[feats])[:, 1]
        if cal is None:
            return p_te
        oof = np.zeros(len(tr))
        for a, b in GroupKFold(5).split(X, y, tr.StyleCode):
            oof[b] = _gbm().fit(X.iloc[a], y[a]).predict_proba(X.iloc[b])[:, 1]
        if cal == "platt":
            return LogisticRegression(C=1e6).fit(_logit(oof).reshape(-1, 1), y).predict_proba(_logit(p_te).reshape(-1, 1))[:, 1]
        return IsotonicRegression(out_of_bounds="clip", y_min=0, y_max=1).fit(oof, y).predict(p_te)
    return f


def m_M3(tr, te, tau):
    ok = tr.mu3.notna()
    res = (tr.st55 - tr.mu3)[ok]
    bias_k = res.groupby(tr.k[ok]).mean()
    s_k = _sigma((res - tr.k[ok].map(bias_k)).to_numpy(), tr.k[ok].to_numpy(), te.k.to_numpy())
    mu = te.mu3 + te.k.map(bias_k).fillna(0.0)
    sd = np.sqrt(te.s_fit.fillna(0.0).to_numpy() ** 2 + s_k ** 2)
    p = norm.cdf((tau - mu.to_numpy()) / sd)
    return np.where(te.mu3.isna(), np.nan, p)


BASE = {"B0g": m_B0g, "B0": m_B0, "B1": m_B1, "B2": m_B2}
METH = {
    **BASE,
    "M1a": make_logit(FE_M1),
    "M1a bez avail_core": make_logit([f for f in FE_M1 if f != "avail_core"]),
    "M1a bez ln_price": make_logit([f for f in FE_M1 if f != "ln_price"]),
    "M1a bez restock": make_logit([f for f in FE_M1 if f != "restock"]),
    "M1r": make_ridge(FE_M1),
    "M2": make_gbm(FE_M2),
    "M2 + Platt": make_gbm(FE_M2, "platt"),
    "M2 + izotoniczna": make_gbm(FE_M2, "iso"),
    "M3": m_M3,
}
# cechy per metoda (do parametrów uruchomień); None = metoda bez cech z tabeli (częstość bazowa) lub wyłącznie pred55
FEATURES = {
    "B0g": [], "B0": ["Category"], "B1": ["pred55"], "B2": ["pred55", "Category"],
    "M1a": FE_M1, "M1a bez avail_core": [f for f in FE_M1 if f != "avail_core"],
    "M1a bez ln_price": [f for f in FE_M1 if f != "ln_price"], "M1a bez restock": [f for f in FE_M1 if f != "restock"],
    "M1r": FE_M1, "M2": FE_M2, "M2 + Platt": FE_M2, "M2 + izotoniczna": FE_M2, "M3": ["mu3", "s_fit"],
}
HYPER = {
    "B0g": "brak", "B0": "skurczenie n/(n+30) do częstości globalnej", "B1": "sigma_k z treningu; P=Phi((tau-pred55)/sigma_k)",
    "B2": "korekta kategorii skurczona n/(n+30)",
    "M1a": "LogisticRegression C=1, L2, StandardScaler", "M1a bez avail_core": "jak M1a bez avail_core",
    "M1a bez ln_price": "jak M1a bez ln_price", "M1a bez restock": "jak M1a bez restock",
    "M1r": "Ridge alpha=3 na st55, P=Phi((tau-mu)/sigma_k)",
    "M2": "LGBM depth=2 leaves=4 n=150 lr=0.03 reg_lambda=5 min_child=20 subsample=0.8 colsample=0.8 n_jobs=1",
    "M2 + Platt": "jak M2 + kalibracja Platta (OOF GroupKFold 5)", "M2 + izotoniczna": "jak M2 + kalibracja izotoniczna (OOF GroupKFold 5)",
    "M3": "krzywa A(1-exp(-(t+1)/theta)), bootstrap reszt 40x, bias_k i sigma_k z treningu",
}


def run_cv(methods, tau, data):
    outs = []
    for test_c in COLLS:
        tr, te = data[data.Collection != test_c], data[data.Collection == test_c]
        o = te.copy()
        o["y"] = label(te, tau)
        for name, f in methods.items():
            inner = pd.concat([pd.Series(f(tr[tr.Collection != c], tr[tr.Collection == c], tau), index=tr[tr.Collection == c].index)
                               for c in tr.Collection.unique()])
            o["p__" + name] = f(tr, te, tau)
            o["thr__" + name] = te.k.map(pick_threshold(tr.loc[inner.index], inner.to_numpy(), tau)).to_numpy()
        o["thr_theory"] = te.k.map(theory_threshold(tr, tau)).to_numpy()
        outs.append(o)
    return pd.concat(outs, ignore_index=True)


def ridge_mu_sd(tr, te, feats=FE_M1, alpha=3.0):
    m = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), Ridge(alpha=alpha)).fit(tr[feats], tr.st55)
    res = (tr.st55 - m.predict(tr[feats])).to_numpy() * np.sqrt(len(tr) / (len(tr) - len(feats) - 1))
    return m.predict(te[feats]), _sigma(res, tr.k.to_numpy(), te.k.to_numpy())


def ev_flag(te, mu, sd, tau, delta=None, d_clear=None, eps=None, hold=None):
    delta = COST["delta"] if delta is None else delta
    d_clear = COST["delta_clear"] if d_clear is None else d_clear
    eps = EPS if eps is None else eps
    hold = COST["hold_m"] if hold is None else hold
    z = (tau - mu) / sd
    exp_short = sd * (norm.pdf(z) + z * norm.cdf(z))
    k_miss = exp_short * te.supply_d.to_numpy() * (d_clear * te.p.to_numpy() + hold * COST["hold_months"] * te.c.to_numpy())
    k_flag = delta * te.p.to_numpy() * np.maximum(mu - te.st_d.to_numpy(), 0) * te.supply_d.to_numpy()
    return k_flag + (1 - eps) * k_miss < k_miss


def add_ev(O, D, tau=TAU):
    """Prognoza ciągła M1r (uczona na kolekcjach treningowych foldu) i flaga reguły kosztowej EV."""
    O["mu_r"], O["sd_r"] = np.nan, np.nan
    for c in COLLS:
        tr_, te_ = D[D.Collection != c], D[D.Collection == c]
        mu_, sd_ = ridge_mu_sd(tr_, te_)
        ix = O.index[O.Collection == c]
        O.loc[ix, "mu_r"], O.loc[ix, "sd_r"] = mu_, sd_
    O["flag__EV"] = ev_flag(O, O.mu_r.to_numpy(), O.sd_r.to_numpy(), tau)
    return O


def policy_cost(O, tau, flag, **kw):
    ct = cost_table(O, tau, **kw)
    return np.where(flag, ct.c_flag, ct.c_no)


def rule_cost(O, m, tau, which="tuned", **kw):
    thr = O["thr__" + m] if which == "tuned" else O["thr_theory"]
    return policy_cost(O, tau, O["p__" + m] > thr, **kw)


def basic_policies(O, tau):
    return {"nie flaguj nigdy": np.zeros(len(O), bool), "flaguj zawsze": np.ones(len(O), bool),
            "praktyka robocza (ST < prosta do celu)": (O.st_d < tau * (O.d + 1) / 56).to_numpy()}


def boot_setup(O, B=1000, seed=SEED):
    ids = O.StyleCode.unique()
    return ids, np.random.default_rng(seed).multinomial(len(ids), np.ones(len(ids)) / len(ids), size=B)


def _by_model(O, vals, ids):
    t = pd.DataFrame({"v": np.asarray(vals, float), "n": 1.0, "id": O.StyleCode.to_numpy()}).groupby("id").sum().reindex(ids)
    return t.v.to_numpy(), t.n.to_numpy()


def boot_mean(O, vals, bs):
    ids, W = bs
    v, n = _by_model(O, vals, ids)
    return v.sum() / n.sum(), np.quantile((W @ v) / (W @ n), [0.05, 0.95])


def sq_err(O, m):
    return (O["p__" + m] - O.y) ** 2


def log_loss_rows(O, m):
    p = O["p__" + m].clip(1e-3, 1 - 1e-3)
    return -(O.y * np.log(p) + (1 - O.y) * np.log(1 - p))


def ece(p, y, bins=5):
    b = np.minimum((np.asarray(p) * bins).astype(int), bins - 1)
    return sum((b == i).mean() * abs(np.asarray(p)[b == i].mean() - np.asarray(y)[b == i].mean()) for i in range(bins) if (b == i).any())


def auc(O, m):
    return roc_auc_score(O.y, O["p__" + m]) if O["p__" + m].nunique() > 1 else 0.5


def calib_curve(O, m, bins=5, B=400, seed=3):
    b = np.minimum((O["p__" + m] * bins).astype(int), bins - 1).to_numpy()
    ids_ = O.StyleCode.unique()
    rg = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    out = []
    for i in range(bins):
        msk = b == i
        if msk.sum() < 5:
            continue
        v, n = _by_model(O, np.where(msk, O.y, 0), ids_)[0], _by_model(O, msk.astype(float), ids_)[0]
        Wb = rg.multinomial(len(ids_), np.ones(len(ids_)) / len(ids_), size=B)
        den = Wb @ n
        est = np.where(den > 0, (Wb @ v) / np.where(den > 0, den, 1), np.nan)
        out.append((O["p__" + m][msk].mean(), O.y[msk].mean(), *np.nanquantile(est, [.05, .95]), int(msk.sum())))
    return pd.DataFrame(out, columns=["p_śr", "udział", "od", "do", "n"])


def run_main_cv(ds: SimpleNamespace):
    """Cała walidacja z fazy 6: LOCO dla wszystkich metod + EV. Zwraca tabelę out-of-fold (jak `O` w notebooku)."""
    O = run_cv(METH, TAU, ds.D)
    O["p__M3"] = O["p__M3"].fillna(O["p__B1"])
    return add_ev(O, ds.D)
```

```
"""E3: jedno uruchomienie MLflow na metodę z poprzedniego zadania (walidacja LOCO), jawne logowanie bez autologu.

Użycie: MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI=http://127.0.0.1:5000 python src/log_runs.py [--experiment NAZWA]
Nie loguje sekretów ani zmiennych środowiskowych; artefakty to małe pliki (wykres, prognozy walidacyjne, cechy).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import uuid
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import mlflow
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from mlflow import MlflowClient
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression, Ridge
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

import bc04_core as core

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA = Path(os.getenv("NORDVIK_BC04_DATA", HERE.parents[2] / "datasets/synthetic/bc04")).resolve()
EXPERIMENT = "bc04-sell-through-przecena"

STATUS = {"B0g": "punkt_odniesienia", "B0": "punkt_odniesienia", "B1": "punkt_odniesienia", "B2": "punkt_odniesienia",
          "M1a": "kandydat (metoda główna wskazana z góry)", "M1r": "kandydat", "M2": "kandydat", "M2 + Platt": "kandydat",
          "M2 + izotoniczna": "kandydat", "M3": "kandydat",
          "M1a bez avail_core": "ablacja", "M1a bez ln_price": "ablacja", "M1a bez restock": "ablacja"}


def data_version() -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    for t in core.TABLES:
        h.update(hashlib.sha256((DATA / f"{t}.parquet").read_bytes()).digest())
    return h.hexdigest()


def code_version() -> dict:
    sha = hashlib.sha256((Path(core.__file__)).read_bytes()).hexdigest()[:16]
    try:
        commit = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(HERE), "rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
    except Exception:
        commit = "brak-git"
    return {"git_commit": commit, "core_sha256": sha}


def fold_metrics(O: pd.DataFrame, m: str, tau: float) -> dict:
    """Metryki zbiorcze (z przedziałem bootstrap po modelach) i per kolekcja testowa (fold LOCO)."""
    bs = core.boot_setup(O)
    br, brci = core.boot_mean(O, core.sq_err(O, m), bs)
    ll, _ = core.boot_mean(O, core.log_loss_rows(O, m), bs)
    ct, ctci = core.boot_mean(O, core.rule_cost(O, m, tau), bs)
    cth, _ = core.boot_mean(O, core.rule_cost(O, m, tau, "theory"), bs)
    out = {"brier": br, "brier_ci90_lo": brci[0], "brier_ci90_hi": brci[1], "log_loss": ll, "auc": core.auc(O, m),
           "ece_5": core.ece(O["p__" + m], O.y), "cost_per_row_tuned": ct, "cost_tuned_ci90_lo": ctci[0], "cost_tuned_ci90_hi": ctci[1],
           "cost_per_row_theory": cth, "n_rows": len(O), "n_models": O.StyleCode.nunique(), "risk_base_rate": O.y.mean()}
    for c in core.COLLS:
        g = O[O.Collection == c]
        out[f"brier__{c}"] = core.sq_err(g, m).mean()
        out[f"log_loss__{c}"] = core.log_loss_rows(g, m).mean()
        out[f"cost_per_row_tuned__{c}"] = core.rule_cost(g, m, tau).mean()
        out[f"n_rows__{c}"], out[f"n_models__{c}"] = len(g), g.StyleCode.nunique()
        if g.y.nunique() > 1:
            out[f"auc__{c}"] = core.auc(g, m)
    return out


def calibration_png(O, m, path):
    cc = core.calib_curve(O, m)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.5, 4))
    ax.errorbar(cc.p_śr, cc.udział, yerr=[cc.udział - cc.od, cc.do - cc.udział], fmt="o-", capsize=3)
    ax.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], "k:", lw=0.8)
    ax.set_title(f"{m}: kalibracja (LOCO, {O.StyleCode.nunique()} modeli)")
    ax.set_xlabel("przewidywane prawdopodobieństwo ryzyka [-]")
    ax.set_ylabel("faktyczny udział ryzykownych (τ = 60%) [-]")
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(path)
    plt.close(fig)


def coefficients(D: pd.DataFrame, m: str) -> pd.DataFrame | None:
    feats = core.FEATURES[m]
    if m.startswith("M1a"):
        est = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(C=1.0, max_iter=2000)).fit(D[feats], core.label(D, core.TAU))
        return pd.DataFrame({"cecha": feats, "wspolczynnik_std": est[-1].coef_[0]})
    if m == "M1r":
        est = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), Ridge(alpha=3.0)).fit(D[feats], D.st55)
        return pd.DataFrame({"cecha": feats, "wspolczynnik_std": est[-1].coef_})
    return None


def common_tags(kind, status, reason, suite, dv, cv, scope):
    return {"kind": kind, "status": status, "reason": reason, "suite_id": suite, "data_version_sha256": dv, "git_commit": cv["git_commit"],
            "code_sha256_core": cv["core_sha256"], "decision_days": ",".join(map(str, core.DAYS)), "validation": "LOCO po kolekcjach (SS25, AW25, SS26)",
            "scope": scope}


def common_params(extra: dict) -> dict:
    p = {"seed": core.SEED, "tau": core.TAU, "decision_days": str(core.DAYS), "validation": "LOCO", "bootstrap": "po modelach, B=1000, 90%",
         **{f"cost_{k}": v for k, v in core.COST.items() if k != "tau"}}
    p.update(extra)
    return p


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--experiment", default=EXPERIMENT)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    mlflow.set_tracking_uri(os.getenv("MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI", "http://127.0.0.1:5000"))
    mlflow.set_experiment(args.experiment)
    client = MlflowClient()
    dv, cv, suite = data_version(), code_version(), uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
    print("klient", mlflow.__version__, "| dane", dv[:12], "| kod", cv, "| suite", suite)

    t_all = time.time()
    t0 = time.time()
    ds = core.build_dataset(DATA, HERE / "cache")
    t_data = time.time() - t0
    D = ds.D
    scope = f"{D.StyleCode.nunique()} modeli (bez 6 cenzurowanych), {len(D)} wierszy model x moment"
    run_ids = []

    for m, f in core.METH.items():
        t0 = time.time()
        methods = {m: f, "B1": core.m_B1} if m == "M3" else {m: f}
        O = core.run_cv(methods, core.TAU, D)
        n_fallback = int(O["p__M3"].isna().sum()) if m == "M3" else 0
        if m == "M3":
            O["p__M3"] = O["p__M3"].fillna(O["p__B1"])
        t_val = time.time() - t0
        met = fold_metrics(O, m, core.TAU)
        met["validation_elapsed_s"] = t_val
        params = common_params({"method": m, "features": ",".join(core.FEATURES[m]), "hyperparameters": core.HYPER[m],
                                "m3_fallback_rows": n_fallback if m == "M3" else "n/a"})
        reason = {"M1a": "metoda główna wskazana z góry w fazie 6; w notebooku nie pobiła B1"}.get(m, "")
        with mlflow.start_run(run_name=f"{m}__loco__{dv[:8]}") as run:
            mlflow.log_params(params)
            mlflow.set_tags(common_tags("metoda", STATUS[m], reason, suite, dv, cv, scope))
            mlflow.log_metrics({k: float(v) for k, v in met.items()})
            mlflow.log_dict({"method": m, "features": core.FEATURES[m]}, "features.json")
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
                calibration_png(O, m, Path(td) / "calibration.png")
                mlflow.log_artifact(str(Path(td) / "calibration.png"))
                oof = O[["StyleCode", "Collection", "Category", "k", "d", "y", "st_d", "st55"]].assign(p=O["p__" + m], thr_tuned=O["thr__" + m], thr_theory=O.thr_theory)
                oof.to_csv(Path(td) / "oof_predictions.csv", index=False)
                mlflow.log_artifact(str(Path(td) / "oof_predictions.csv"))
                coef = coefficients(D, m)
                if coef is not None:
                    coef.to_csv(Path(td) / "coefficients.csv", index=False)
                    mlflow.log_artifact(str(Path(td) / "coefficients.csv"))
        run_ids.append(run.info.run_id)
        print(f"{m:22s} Brier {met['brier']:.4f} | LL {met['log_loss']:.4f} | AUC {met['auc']:.4f} | czas {t_val:5.1f}s")

    # polityki bez modelu i reguła kosztowa EV: koszt decyzji bez prognozy (pytanie: czy metoda bije dzisiejszą praktykę)
    Op = core.add_ev(core.run_cv({"B0g": core.m_B0g}, core.TAU, D), D)
    ct = core.cost_table(Op, core.TAU)
    pol = dict(core.basic_policies(Op, core.TAU))
    pol["reguła kosztowa EV (M1r)"] = Op.flag__EV.to_numpy()
    bs = core.boot_setup(Op)
    for name, fl in pol.items():
        v = np.where(fl, ct.c_flag, ct.c_no)
        est, ci = core.boot_mean(Op, v, bs)
        met = {"cost_per_row_tuned": est, "cost_tuned_ci90_lo": ci[0], "cost_tuned_ci90_hi": ci[1], "n_rows": len(Op), "n_models": Op.StyleCode.nunique(),
               "flag_share": float(np.mean(fl))}
        for c in core.COLLS:
            ix = (Op.Collection == c).to_numpy()
            met[f"cost_per_row_tuned__{c}"] = float(v[ix].mean())
            met[f"n_rows__{c}"], met[f"n_models__{c}"] = int(ix.sum()), Op[ix].StyleCode.nunique()
        with mlflow.start_run(run_name=f"polityka: {name}__loco__{dv[:8]}"):
            mlflow.log_params(common_params({"method": name, "features": "", "hyperparameters": "polityka bez modelu (koszt decyzji)"}))
            mlflow.set_tags(common_tags("polityka", "punkt_odniesienia", "porównanie kosztu z dzisiejszą praktyką", suite, dv, cv, scope))
            mlflow.log_metrics({k: float(v_) for k, v_ in met.items()})
        run_ids.append(mlflow.last_active_run().info.run_id if mlflow.last_active_run() else "")
        print(f"[polityka] {name:42s} koszt/wiersz {est:,.0f}")

    total = time.time() - t_all
    for r in client.search_runs([client.get_experiment_by_name(args.experiment).experiment_id], filter_string=f"tags.suite_id = '{suite}'"):
        client.set_tag(r.info.run_id, "suite_elapsed_s", f"{total:.1f}")
        client.set_tag(r.info.run_id, "suite_data_build_s", f"{t_data:.1f}")
    print(f"Pełne porównanie: {total:.1f}s (w tym dane i M3: {t_data:.1f}s) | suite_id={suite}")
    (HERE / "reference").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (HERE / "reference" / "last_suite.json").write_text(json.dumps({"suite_id": suite, "experiment": args.experiment, "elapsed_s": total}))
```

```
"""E3: jedno uruchomienie MLflow na metodę z poprzedniego zadania (walidacja LOCO), jawne logowanie bez autologu.

Użycie: MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI=http://127.0.0.1:5000 python src/log_runs.py [--experiment NAZWA]
Nie loguje sekretów ani zmiennych środowiskowych; artefakty to małe pliki (wykres, prognozy walidacyjne, cechy).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import uuid
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import mlflow
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from mlflow import MlflowClient
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression, Ridge
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

import bc04_core as core

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA = Path(os.getenv("NORDVIK_BC04_DATA", HERE.parents[2] / "datasets/synthetic/bc04")).resolve()
EXPERIMENT = "bc04-sell-through-przecena"

STATUS = {"B0g": "punkt_odniesienia", "B0": "punkt_odniesienia", "B1": "punkt_odniesienia", "B2": "punkt_odniesienia",
          "M1a": "kandydat (metoda główna wskazana z góry)", "M1r": "kandydat", "M2": "kandydat", "M2 + Platt": "kandydat",
          "M2 + izotoniczna": "kandydat", "M3": "kandydat",
          "M1a bez avail_core": "ablacja", "M1a bez ln_price": "ablacja", "M1a bez restock": "ablacja"}


def data_version() -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    for t in core.TABLES:
        h.update(hashlib.sha256((DATA / f"{t}.parquet").read_bytes()).digest())
    return h.hexdigest()


def code_version() -> dict:
    sha = hashlib.sha256((Path(core.__file__)).read_bytes()).hexdigest()[:16]
    try:
        commit = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(HERE), "rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
    except Exception:
        commit = "brak-git"
    return {"git_commit": commit, "core_sha256": sha}


def fold_metrics(O: pd.DataFrame, m: str, tau: float) -> dict:
    """Metryki zbiorcze (z przedziałem bootstrap po modelach) i per kolekcja testowa (fold LOCO)."""
    bs = core.boot_setup(O)
    br, brci = core.boot_mean(O, core.sq_err(O, m), bs)
    ll, _ = core.boot_mean(O, core.log_loss_rows(O, m), bs)
    ct, ctci = core.boot_mean(O, core.rule_cost(O, m, tau), bs)
    cth, _ = core.boot_mean(O, core.rule_cost(O, m, tau, "theory"), bs)
    out = {"brier": br, "brier_ci90_lo": brci[0], "brier_ci90_hi": brci[1], "log_loss": ll, "auc": core.auc(O, m),
           "ece_5": core.ece(O["p__" + m], O.y), "cost_per_row_tuned": ct, "cost_tuned_ci90_lo": ctci[0], "cost_tuned_ci90_hi": ctci[1],
           "cost_per_row_theory": cth, "n_rows": len(O), "n_models": O.StyleCode.nunique(), "risk_base_rate": O.y.mean()}
    for c in core.COLLS:
        g = O[O.Collection == c]
        out[f"brier__{c}"] = core.sq_err(g, m).mean()
        out[f"log_loss__{c}"] = core.log_loss_rows(g, m).mean()
        out[f"cost_per_row_tuned__{c}"] = core.rule_cost(g, m, tau).mean()
        out[f"n_rows__{c}"], out[f"n_models__{c}"] = len(g), g.StyleCode.nunique()
        if g.y.nunique() > 1:
            out[f"auc__{c}"] = core.auc(g, m)
    return out


def calibration_png(O, m, path):
    cc = core.calib_curve(O, m)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.5, 4))
    ax.errorbar(cc.p_śr, cc.udział, yerr=[cc.udział - cc.od, cc.do - cc.udział], fmt="o-", capsize=3)
    ax.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], "k:", lw=0.8)
    ax.set_title(f"{m}: kalibracja (LOCO, {O.StyleCode.nunique()} modeli)")
    ax.set_xlabel("przewidywane prawdopodobieństwo ryzyka [-]")
    ax.set_ylabel("faktyczny udział ryzykownych (τ = 60%) [-]")
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(path)
    plt.close(fig)


def coefficients(D: pd.DataFrame, m: str) -> pd.DataFrame | None:
    feats = core.FEATURES[m]
    if m.startswith("M1a"):
        est = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(C=1.0, max_iter=2000)).fit(D[feats], core.label(D, core.TAU))
        return pd.DataFrame({"cecha": feats, "wspolczynnik_std": est[-1].coef_[0]})
    if m == "M1r":
        est = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), Ridge(alpha=3.0)).fit(D[feats], D.st55)
        return pd.DataFrame({"cecha": feats, "wspolczynnik_std": est[-1].coef_})
    return None


def common_tags(kind, status, reason, suite, dv, cv, scope):
    return {"kind": kind, "status": status, "reason": reason, "suite_id": suite, "data_version_sha256": dv, "git_commit": cv["git_commit"],
            "code_sha256_core": cv["core_sha256"], "decision_days": ",".join(map(str, core.DAYS)), "validation": "LOCO po kolekcjach (SS25, AW25, SS26)",
            "scope": scope}


def common_params(extra: dict) -> dict:
    p = {"seed": core.SEED, "tau": core.TAU, "decision_days": str(core.DAYS), "validation": "LOCO", "bootstrap": "po modelach, B=1000, 90%",
         **{f"cost_{k}": v for k, v in core.COST.items() if k != "tau"}}
    p.update(extra)
    return p


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--experiment", default=EXPERIMENT)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    mlflow.set_tracking_uri(os.getenv("MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI", "http://127.0.0.1:5000"))
    mlflow.set_experiment(args.experiment)
    client = MlflowClient()
    dv, cv, suite = data_version(), code_version(), uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
    print("klient", mlflow.__version__, "| dane", dv[:12], "| kod", cv, "| suite", suite)

    t_all = time.time()
    t0 = time.time()
    ds = core.build_dataset(DATA, HERE / "cache")
    t_data = time.time() - t0
    D = ds.D
    scope = f"{D.StyleCode.nunique()} modeli (bez 6 cenzurowanych), {len(D)} wierszy model x moment"
    run_ids = []

    for m, f in core.METH.items():
        t0 = time.time()
        methods = {m: f, "B1": core.m_B1} if m == "M3" else {m: f}
        O = core.run_cv(methods, core.TAU, D)
        n_fallback = int(O["p__M3"].isna().sum()) if m == "M3" else 0
        if m == "M3":
            O["p__M3"] = O["p__M3"].fillna(O["p__B1"])
        t_val = time.time() - t0
        met = fold_metrics(O, m, core.TAU)
        met["validation_elapsed_s"] = t_val
        params = common_params({"method": m, "features": ",".join(core.FEATURES[m]), "hyperparameters": core.HYPER[m],
                                "m3_fallback_rows": n_fallback if m == "M3" else "n/a"})
        reason = {"M1a": "metoda główna wskazana z góry w fazie 6; w notebooku nie pobiła B1"}.get(m, "")
        with mlflow.start_run(run_name=f"{m}__loco__{dv[:8]}") as run:
            mlflow.log_params(params)
            mlflow.set_tags(common_tags("metoda", STATUS[m], reason, suite, dv, cv, scope))
            mlflow.log_metrics({k: float(v) for k, v in met.items()})
            mlflow.log_dict({"method": m, "features": core.FEATURES[m]}, "features.json")
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
                calibration_png(O, m, Path(td) / "calibration.png")
                mlflow.log_artifact(str(Path(td) / "calibration.png"))
                oof = O[["StyleCode", "Collection", "Category", "k", "d", "y", "st_d", "st55"]].assign(p=O["p__" + m], thr_tuned=O["thr__" + m], thr_theory=O.thr_theory)
                oof.to_csv(Path(td) / "oof_predictions.csv", index=False)
                mlflow.log_artifact(str(Path(td) / "oof_predictions.csv"))
                coef = coefficients(D, m)
                if coef is not None:
                    coef.to_csv(Path(td) / "coefficients.csv", index=False)
                    mlflow.log_artifact(str(Path(td) / "coefficients.csv"))
        run_ids.append(run.info.run_id)
        print(f"{m:22s} Brier {met['brier']:.4f} | LL {met['log_loss']:.4f} | AUC {met['auc']:.4f} | czas {t_val:5.1f}s")

    # polityki bez modelu i reguła kosztowa EV: koszt decyzji bez prognozy (pytanie: czy metoda bije dzisiejszą praktykę)
    Op = core.add_ev(core.run_cv({"B0g": core.m_B0g}, core.TAU, D), D)
    ct = core.cost_table(Op, core.TAU)
    pol = dict(core.basic_policies(Op, core.TAU))
    pol["reguła kosztowa EV (M1r)"] = Op.flag__EV.to_numpy()
    bs = core.boot_setup(Op)
    for name, fl in pol.items():
        v = np.where(fl, ct.c_flag, ct.c_no)
        est, ci = core.boot_mean(Op, v, bs)
        met = {"cost_per_row_tuned": est, "cost_tuned_ci90_lo": ci[0], "cost_tuned_ci90_hi": ci[1], "n_rows": len(Op), "n_models": Op.StyleCode.nunique(),
               "flag_share": float(np.mean(fl))}
        for c in core.COLLS:
            ix = (Op.Collection == c).to_numpy()
            met[f"cost_per_row_tuned__{c}"] = float(v[ix].mean())
            met[f"n_rows__{c}"], met[f"n_models__{c}"] = int(ix.sum()), Op[ix].StyleCode.nunique()
        with mlflow.start_run(run_name=f"polityka: {name}__loco__{dv[:8]}"):
            mlflow.log_params(common_params({"method": name, "features": "", "hyperparameters": "polityka bez modelu (koszt decyzji)"}))
            mlflow.set_tags(common_tags("polityka", "punkt_odniesienia", "porównanie kosztu z dzisiejszą praktyką", suite, dv, cv, scope))
            mlflow.log_metrics({k: float(v_) for k, v_ in met.items()})
        run_ids.append(mlflow.last_active_run().info.run_id if mlflow.last_active_run() else "")
        print(f"[polityka] {name:42s} koszt/wiersz {est:,.0f}")

    total = time.time() - t_all
    for r in client.search_runs([client.get_experiment_by_name(args.experiment).experiment_id], filter_string=f"tags.suite_id = '{suite}'"):
        client.set_tag(r.info.run_id, "suite_elapsed_s", f"{total:.1f}")
        client.set_tag(r.info.run_id, "suite_data_build_s", f"{t_data:.1f}")
    print(f"Pełne porównanie: {total:.1f}s (w tym dane i M3: {t_data:.1f}s) | suite_id={suite}")
    (HERE / "reference").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (HERE / "reference" / "last_suite.json").write_text(json.dumps({"suite_id": suite, "experiment": args.experiment, "elapsed_s": total}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```
"""Parytet rejestru MLflow z notebookiem (liczby referencyjne z kopii wykonanego notebooka) oraz brak sekretów.

Wymaga działającego serwera (MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI) i wcześniejszych: run_reference.py, log_runs.py.
"""
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import mlflow
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import pytest
from mlflow import MlflowClient

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE / "src"))
import bc04_core as core  # noqa: E402
import log_runs  # noqa: E402

REF = HERE / "reference"
URI = os.getenv("MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI", "http://127.0.0.1:5000")
mlflow.set_tracking_uri(URI)
last = json.loads((REF / "last_suite.json").read_text())
client = MlflowClient()
EXP = client.get_experiment_by_name(last["experiment"]).experiment_id
RUNS = {r.data.params["method"]: r for r in client.search_runs([EXP], filter_string=f"tags.suite_id = '{last['suite_id']}'")}
OREF = pd.read_parquet(REF / "ref_O_final.parquet")
TAB6 = pd.read_csv(REF / "ref_tab6.csv").set_index("metoda")


def test_client_equals_server_version():
    r = __import__("requests").get(URI + "/version", timeout=10)
    assert r.text.strip() == mlflow.__version__ == "3.5.0"


def test_one_run_per_method_and_policy():
    assert set(core.METH) <= set(RUNS)
    assert len(RUNS) == len(core.METH) + 4


@pytest.mark.parametrize("m", list(core.METH))
def test_pooled_metrics_equal_notebook_table(m):
    got, ref = RUNS[m].data.metrics, TAB6.loc[m]
    pairs = {"brier": "Brier", "brier_ci90_lo": "Brier 90% od", "brier_ci90_hi": "Brier 90% do", "log_loss": "log loss", "auc": "AUC",
             "ece_5": "ECE (5 przedziałów)", "cost_per_row_tuned": "koszt/wiersz (próg z walidacji)", "cost_tuned_ci90_lo": "koszt od",
             "cost_tuned_ci90_hi": "koszt do", "cost_per_row_theory": "koszt (próg teoretyczny)"}
    for k, col in pairs.items():
        assert got[k] == pytest.approx(ref[col], rel=1e-9, abs=1e-9), (m, k)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("m", list(core.METH))
def test_per_collection_metrics_equal_notebook_oof(m):
    exp = log_runs.fold_metrics(OREF, m, core.TAU)
    got = RUNS[m].data.metrics
    for k, v in exp.items():
        assert got[k] == pytest.approx(v, rel=1e-9, abs=1e-9), (m, k)


def test_no_secrets_in_params_and_tags():
    bad = ("password", "passwd", "secret", "token", "postgresql://", "api_key")
    for r in RUNS.values():
        for k, v in {**r.data.params, **r.data.tags}.items():
            assert not any(b in f"{k}={v}".lower() for b in bad), (r.info.run_name, k)
            assert k not in os.environ

```

```
## Transform: specyfikacja i konwencje śledzenia (E0, E2)

**Metody (z poprzedniego zadania):** B0g, B0, B1, B2 (punkty odniesienia), M1a (metoda główna wskazana z góry w fazie 6), trzy ablacje M1a, M1r, M2 (+ Platt, + izotoniczna), M3. Dodatkowo cztery „polityki bez modelu” (nie flaguj nigdy / flaguj zawsze / praktyka robocza / reguła kosztowa EV), bo odpowiadają na pytanie biznesowe „czy to jest tańsze niż dziś”.

**Konwencje (każda odpowiada na pytanie audytora):**

| Element | Konwencja | Pytanie, na które odpowiada |
|---|---|---|
| Eksperyment | `bc04-sell-through-przecena` (test klienta osobno: `bc04-e1-test-klienta`) | gdzie leży porównanie, a gdzie test środowiska |
| Nazwa uruchomienia | `<metoda>__loco__<8 znaków sumy kontrolnej danych>` | która metoda, jaka walidacja, jaka wersja danych |
| Parametry | `method`, `features`, `hyperparameters`, `seed`, `tau`, `cost_*`, `decision_days`, `validation`, `bootstrap` | co dokładnie zostało uruchomione; założenia kosztowe widoczne dla audytora |
| Metryki | `brier`, `log_loss`, `auc`, `ece_5`, `cost_per_row_*` zbiorczo, z `*_ci90_*`, oraz `<metryka>__<kolekcja>`; liczebności `n_rows`, `n_models` (także per kolekcja) | jak dobra jest metoda i **ile modeli** stoi za liczbą |
| Artefakty | `calibration.png`, `oof_predictions.csv` (396 wierszy), `features.json`, `coefficients.csv` (tylko M1a, M1r) | można zobaczyć kalibrację i odtworzyć metryki bez uruchamiania kodu |
| Tagi | `data_version_sha256`, `git_commit`, `code_sha256_core`, `status`, `reason`, `suite_id`, `decision_days`, `scope`, `suite_elapsed_s` | która wersja danych i kodu, co jest kandydatem, a co punktem odniesienia |
| Zasada | jedno uruchomienie na metodę, bez zagnieżdżonych uruchomień i bez autologu | nie zaśmiecać rejestru setkami uruchomień z pętli walidacji |
| Czego nie logujemy | sekretów, zmiennych środowiskowych, surowych danych | wszystko w parametrach i tagach widzą wszyscy użytkownicy serwera |

**Czego świadomie nie rejestruję:** ślepych uliczek z dziennika poprzedniego zadania (brak kodu do ich odtworzenia, więc nie fabrykuję historii), wersji pośrednich oraz testów wrażliwości (próg 50/70%, scenariusze kosztów) — to osobne pytania, nie część porównania metod.
""")

md("""
### Parytet z notebookiem

**Po co:** liczby w rejestrze muszą być identyczne z notebookiem (te same ziarna i wersje bibliotek). Rozbieżność byłaby wynikiem do zbadania, nie czymś do „dostrojenia”. Sprawdzam trzy rzeczy: (1) metryki zbiorcze z rejestru vs tabela `tab6` z kopii notebooka, (2) metryki per kolekcja z rejestru vs te same metryki policzone z `O` z kopii notebooka, (3) prognozy z artefaktów `oof_predictions.csv` vs kolumny `p__*` z `O` (0 = brak różnicy). Pełny zestaw sprawdzeń jest w `tests/test_parity.py`.
""")
code("""
Oref = pd.read_parquet("reference/ref_O_final.parquet")
pairs = {"brier": "Brier", "log_loss": "log loss", "auc": "AUC", "ece_5": "ECE (5 przedziałów)", "cost_per_row_tuned": "koszt/wiersz (próg z walidacji)",
         "cost_per_row_theory": "koszt (próg teoretyczny)"}
rows = []
for m in core.METH:
    got = RUNS[m].data.metrics
    exp = log_runs.fold_metrics(Oref, m, core.TAU)  # te same wzory, ale na prognozach z kopii notebooka
    art = pd.read_csv(client.download_artifacts(RUNS[m].info.run_id, "oof_predictions.csv"))
    rows.append({"metoda": m,
                 "max |różnica| vs tab6 (zbiorczo)": max(abs(got[k] - TAB6) for k, TAB6 in ((k, ref.loc[m, c]) for k, c in pairs.items())),
                 "max |różnica| per kolekcja": max(abs(got[k] - v) for k, v in exp.items()),
                 "max |różnica| prognoz p": float(np.max(np.abs(art.p.to_numpy() - Oref["p__" + m].to_numpy())))})
parity = pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("metoda")
display(parity.map(lambda v: f"{v:.1e}"))
print("Parytet pełny (wszystkie różnice < 1e-9):", bool((parity < 1e-9).all().all()))
""")
```
